title: How many people left extreme poverty every day since 1990?
subtitle: Guess how many people left extreme poverty on an average day since 1990, then see the headline no paper ran, and why it may soon stop.
notes: Brief said ~130,000/day for 1990-2015; OWID (Roser 2025, $3 line) gives about 115,000 a day over the last 35 years, used here; the rise after 2030 is Roser quoting the World Bank projection. Review round 2026-10-07: log slider 10 to 1 million, headline written on the paper (? then 115,000 out of poverty today, blue), stadium larger, bars in millions, 2030? label, slow-news label instead of a point under the axis, newspaper back at the end. Bar chart cannot dash a forecast bar. Opening line idles ~6 s over the newspaper.
